description: Source code for parallel checkout functionality in a version control system, managing parallel processing of checkout items, worker setup, result handling, and synchronization.

classes.name: pc_worker
classes.description: Represents a worker process handling part of the parallel checkout.

classes.name: parallel_checkout
classes.description: Holds the state and queue of checkout items for parallel processing.

methods.name: parallel_checkout_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the parallel checkout process.

methods.name: get_parallel_checkout_configs
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for number of workers and parallelism threshold.

methods.name: finish_parallel_checkout
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the parallel checkout state.

methods.name: is_eligible_for_parallel_checkout
methods.description: Determines if a cache entry is suitable for parallel checkout based on its attributes.

methods.name: enqueue_checkout
methods.description: Adds a cache entry to the parallel checkout queue if eligible.

methods.name: pc_queue_size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the checkout queue.

methods.name: handle_results
methods.description: Processes the results of checkout items after worker completion.

methods.name: run_parallel_checkout
methods.description: Executes the parallel checkout process with specified workers and threshold.
